'''Corran Antillies Run Kessel Run''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 28 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 WYS Antillies LS 2003 RunKesse 5108.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This WYS deck uses Raliter Freighter Captains to run lots of kessel runs.  I want to do more with it though.  *Ok, I took out Rebel planners.  It should still work

== Strategy ==

The basic idea of this deck is to hold Kessel and do lots of Kessel running.  Pull Kessel with your objective and everything else with tunnel vision.  Set up a yt 1300 as well as some backup at Kessel and Ralitir.  Initiate a Kessel run targeting a freighter captain, move to kessel, transfer, and move back to pull off a quick retrieval of 10.

Card choices:

Electrobinoculars- I’m still working on tracking.  This is in there to make sure my guesses are right for on the edge

X-wing lazer cannons- take out any minimal space force that my opponent has

Choke- just about everybody is an alien and with bacta tank, I don’t even lose one

Nar shadda wind chimes-  pulls Freighter captains and Raiders as well as gives me a quick retrieval of 3

Kessel Run 3x-  I’ve tried 2x and retrieving one with the other and if I miss a turn in a drain war type game, chances are it’ll be too deep to retrieve

Why no dash and outrider?  It kicks butt, but I can’t do Kessel runs with him

I’ve just recently cut back on the space to make room for the raiders, pt craft, and jedi luke.  Do I need more space?  I’m probably going to replace mirax with naked 3po pretty soon.   Also, I would like to start Battle plan, but I don’t know how to get a strong enough ground force to hold that site.  I’ve seen icebreath’s WYS and am thinking about doing something like that.  What do you think?

Icebreath- I use the non-combos, because of the higher destinys.  Also, the on the edges are extremely important to this deck.  I should have done more explanation on it, but this deck has extremely high destiny.  1/4 of the cards have 5 or higher destinys.  As for the other changes, I'll consider them.
